elements.name: Validate Card allocation features under Card tab for a New Employee

steps.name: User opens the CLMS login application page
User enters username "admin" and password "sa"
User clicks on the Login button
User clicks on the Contractor Employee menu option
User clicks on the Create button
User verifies Aadhaar Card input field is visible
User enters dynamic valid Aadhaar number
User clicks on the Verify link if visible
User should see Submit and Skip Verification options and click Skip Verification
User fills mandatory Personal details with First Name "Mangal", Last Name "Sodhi", Gender "M", and DOB "10-Dec-1918"
User fills Contract Period details with Contract From "29-Aug-2025" and Contract Period In Days "990"

User fills all mandatory Deployment details with Subsidiary "A.k enterprise", Division "Sales", Department "Software", Category "Staff Employee", Grade "B", Designation "Jr Engineer", Location "Pune", Skilled Level "Semi-Skilled", and Contractor "GG ROOT"
User verifies default Status is "Active"
User clicks on the Save button
User clicks on OK button on success popup
User searches created employee status in grid by identity number
User clicks on Edit icon for the created employee
User clicks on "Card" tab in employee profile
User verifies 'Allocate Temporary Card' button is visible
User clicks on "Allocate Temporary Card" button
User verifies "Card Number" label and input textbox are visible
User verifies "Effective From" label and input textbox are visible
User verifies mandatory field red symbols are visible
User verifies "Save" and "Cancel" buttons are visible

elements.name: Validate successful temporary card allocation with dynamic unique card number and today's date

steps.name: User opens the CLMS login application page
User enters username "admin" and password "sa"
User clicks on the Login button
User clicks on the Contractor Employee menu option
User enters "5500" in search filter for Aadhaar or employee details
User selects the 1st entry from the employee grid
User clicks on "Card" tab in employee profile
User clicks on "Allocate Temporary Card" button
User enters dynamic card number based on Aadhaar
User selects today's date in Effective From field
User clicks on the Save button for card allocation
User verifies card allocation success message
